plainText:
Play the Melody That Echoes in the Altar (Japanese: 吹奏！！さいだんに響くメロディ！ Play!! The Melody Reverberating at the Altar!) is the 24th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
, Anabel, and Plumeria follow after Faba.
and Hapu are approached by a group of s.
The Employees retreat when Gladion and Lillie arrive.
The guardian deities take Sun and both flutes to the Poni Altar.
Faba offers to help Plumeria find Guzma if she helps him take over the Aether Foundation.
The guardian deities have Sun and Moon play the Sun Flute and Moon Flute, causing the Altar to react.
